TP_Melusina_Profile_Spec.description: Substrate Toon Profile for Melusina with warm-violet surreal ramp

surreal_feeling.description: Warm-violet shadow replacement (#352D40 replaces black) creates depth perception without HDR blowout. Combined with Lumen GI and CustomDepth=3 stencil, produces soft dreamy toon shading suitable for Melusina's found-family warmth.
surreal_feeling.key_insight: #352D40 (warm violet) as shadow base preserves silhouette clarity while evoking melancholic warmth -- Melusina's feeling state translated into visual language
